summary_1line: Krishna consoles Subhadra promising Arjuna will kill Jayadratha; Subhadra laments deeply over Abhimanyu’s fallen body and prays for his noble afterlife.

image_candidates.scene_text: Subhadra imagines Abhimanyu lying on the battlefield, his ornamented body pierced with arrows and dust-covered face shining like the rising moon.
Krishna solemnly promises that Arjuna will cut off the head of the Sindhu king and make it roll upon the field of Samantapanchaka.
A grieving mother raises her arms and mourns her son who once slept on silk but now lies on the bare earth among jackals.
